data.body: AC amendment: Pin CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT override mechanism in hard-mode tests. Hard-mode tests (test_absence_claim_hard_mode_rejects) MUST export CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT to point at the temp dir before invoking validate-review-output.sh, and MUST unset/restore it in teardown. Tests must also assert the sentinel file path checked by the validator is the temp path (not the real plugins/dso/contracts/ path), to prevent false positives when a real sentinel file later exists in the repo. Add AC criterion: 'Verify: CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=/nonexistent bash plugins/dso/scripts/validate-review-output.sh ... exits 0 (soft mode) even when real sentinel may exist.'
